payload.text: ST0095 WP-12 (from vc, 10:31Z, and ic): add to the fleet note (AC-12.3) that issue 0712 is fixed in cc's WP-04, so a package whose criteria use a one-digit group (eg AC-1.1) now counts them and wp done can block where it did not (Report A: 182 such rows in Devbin, Lamplight and Prolix). Route the five gated joins through ic's read door, `intent id <token>...` (one line per token: id token= kind= id= shown= canon= path=, or ambiguous, unknown, not-an-id; --json too), which lands in WP-10. The retirement proposal goes to vc file by file.
